sentences.en: To speed up address translation, there is a processor-on-a-chip (PoC) cache and associated logic called translation lookaside buffer (TLB).

sentences.en: Proof-of-Concept (PoC) based methods: This is when prototypes used for experiments and simulations are the artifacts that result from the development process.
